text:
Let she who was your eyes' light now turn grief to water, illustrious duke, whose tears every feeling mortal shares.


Your dove fled your nest and makes hers in dawn's arms; she treads and enchants stars, clothed in the new sun.


Weep, for weeping is consolation; let sighs accompanying her in sacrifice not cease.


Weep until you see her; since Heaven took her from envy, pity will compel it to return her.

translation.title: Condolences to Her Husband
